scope: Layer-level diagnostics adapted from DepthBench on existing full pretrained checkpoints; no fixed-budget depth-scaling claim.

models.backbone: 12 layers, width 1024, 16 attention heads, FFN width 4096, tied OLMo tokenizer embedding
models.comparison: Same backbone shape and training-token budget; DAG includes the complete external predictor and local corrections, hence has more parameters. One pretraining seed per family.

wikitext_test.role: Primary out-of-domain evaluation; full existing test cache.

dolma_eval.role: Secondary training-domain evaluation; full existing training-time evaluation cache. Its construction skips 1M streaming documents, but disjointness from the mmap pretraining corpus is not established by this experiment.

metrics: Per-sequence NLL over every valid cached next-token target
Angular distance between embedding/layer-written states, arccos cosine divided by pi
Logit lens CE, KL(final || intermediate), and top-5 overlap using the model's final norm and head
Downstream update causal score after each bypass, plus unnormalized change and original update norms
Supplementary causal score on attention+MLP branch updates, excluding DAG residual remix

dag_interventions.bypass_dynamic: Identity in place of block s; its indexed source slot contains the previous state; downstream local corrections execute normally.
dag_interventions.drop_source_dynamic: Same bypass, and zero the coefficient for source s+1 in every later Q/K/V/R mix. Original indices and signed coefficient magnitudes on other sources remain unchanged.
dag_interventions.bypass_replay: Bypass with effective routing coefficients replayed from the unperturbed forward.
dag_interventions.drop_source_replay: Source-slot removal with effective coefficients replayed, then the skipped source masked.
dag_interventions.scope: These are declared DAG-specific interventions, not an assertion of identical semantics to official AttnRes skipping.

aggregation.unit: Packed token window; paired across models and interventions. Windows are not guaranteed independent original documents.
aggregation.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over windows, 2000 resamples, descriptive 95% intervals; no pretraining-seed uncertainty estimate.
aggregation.late_depth: Blocks s >= ceil(L/4), zero-based, with downstream l > s. Report the mean and fraction of matrix cells above the paper's causal threshold 0.45, alongside losses.
aggregation.interpretation: Neither greater representation change nor greater deletion sensitivity alone demonstrates useful computation.

verification: Before each model's full run, compare native and observed logits exactly, compare final-state readout, check identity skip and unchanged upstream states, and for DAG verify source masking and exact no-intervention replay.
deferred: Permutation analysis requires an explicit convention for moving routing heads with unequal source dimensions. Fixed-budget shallow/middle/deep pretraining is a separate experiment.
